cohort: Women with Chiari malformation type I (CMI) and/or syringomyelia
finding: Neither the mode of delivery nor the type of anesthesia had a significant impact on the clinical course of CMI and/or syringomyelia in the majority of patients.
mod_finding: While the proportion of cesarean deliveries was higher in women diagnosed with or operated on for CMI and/or syringomyelia, neither vaginal nor cesarean delivery was associated with increased clinical deterioration.
